paragraphs: PayNearMe builds payment technology for businesses that need to accept, disburse and manage money. The pitch is a lower total cost of accepting payments, reached by lifting acceptance rates, pushing routine work to self-service and simplifying the exceptions that otherwise need a person.

Among the capabilities listed is a cash at retail network. The stated aim is to let customers pay how, when and where they want. Capabilities are packaged by industry and described as configurable to the demands of each business. For tolling, the site describes improving collection of invoiced tolls by offering drivers more payment options.

PayNearMe says its platform serves thousands of businesses. One published case study involves a toll agency that serves over two million drivers a year and wanted missed toll payments to be easier to make. Money transmission is carried out by two wholly owned subsidiaries that list NMLS identification numbers.

quote.text: PayNearMe develops technology to facilitate the end-to-end customer payment experience, making it easy for businesses to accept, disburse and manage payments.
